messages:
Ana Patel: kickoff for joint webinar w/ CloudArc — Mon Apr 14 10am PT. Agenda: 15m keynote, 25m demo, 10m Q&A. Need final speaker bios + slides by Fri.
Joel Kim: Can we confirm microsite URL? We want co-branding banner + register CTA. @Ana can you share creative?
Ana Patel: working w/ design, expect assets by Thu. Microsite path will be redwood.com/events/cloudarc-demo (will confirm final slug).
Mira Santos: For demo infra, I need a stable model endpoint + sample dataset. Can CloudArc provide a test account? @Sam FYI for credentials.
Sam Ortiz: CloudArc agreed to provide partner test creds; asking for IP allowlist and RT access. I'll follow up with SOW notes.
Kai Nguyen: For on-stage demo, recommend pre-warmed Dedicated node. I'll schedule a smoke test Thu 3pm PT and reserve a GPU pool.
LogisticsBot: Shipping labels created: 3 speaker kits (SKU RC-WEB-01), 50 attendee sticker packs. Carrier: UPS. Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784. Customs: EU batch flagged.
Ana Patel: Swag notes — speaker swag is leather folio + sticker pack + one sample quantized model card. Need customs invoices for EU kit batch. @Sam please confirm HS codes and commercial invoice.
Sam Ortiz: HS codes 4202.22 (leather goods) and 4911.99 (printed matter) confirmed. I'll upload commercial invoice to shared drive: gdrive/partnerships/cloudarc/invoice-APR14.pdf
Joel Kim: AV checklist: wired mic + backup wireless, HDMI adapter stash, spare MacBook with repo + demo token. @Mira can you provide a short runbook script for demo failover?
Mira Santos: yes — will draft a 2-step fallback: 1) switch to recorded demo hosted on S3, 2) failover to slide deck + guided Q&A. Posting runbook by EOD Thu in the runbooks folder.
Ana Patel: also want a short blurb for the registration confirmation email: include link to pre-demo survey and optional hands-on lab slots. @Joel can you draft?
Joel Kim: on it — will drop 2 variants (short + long) by Wed.
Kai Nguyen: reminder: network whitelisting for on-site demo VM needs static egress IP from venue. I emailed venue IT; they asked for a /32.
Sam Ortiz: noted, sharing Redwood egress IPs in the infra sheet. Also looping legal on the partner MSA addendum for test accounts.
Ana Patel: perfect. Next sync Thu 3pm PT after smoke test. Thanks all :shipit:
